verdict.rationale: Persona's API covers most of the agent pipeline. Agents can pre-create inquiries (sessions), poll inquiry statuses, fetch verification details, and run Watchlist/PEP reports via the API, with webhooks for real-time outcomes and simulate actions for programmatic testing. However, scoped credentials are not evidenced: the only key control shown is IP allowlisting. There is also no MCP surface, and an on-demand re-check of a past verification via API is only implied through reports and workflows. missing for 10: scoped/least-privilege API key permissions, an MCP server or agent-specific surface, explicit API-triggered re-verification, independent hands-on corroboration.
